Michelle: FYI I opened a PR that stitches together Dedicated provisioning, autoscale policy docs, SLA blurb, and isolation notes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
Priya: Thanks — can you bullet the main edits so I can write the release note and update the TOC? :slightly_smiling_face:
Michelle: Sure: new autoscale keys (min_instances/max_instances/cpu_target_pct/queue_latency_ms), sample CLI + SDK snippets, SLA language for Dedicated control plane, KMS/HSM steps for Private Dedicated, and a short migration script for old autoscale keys. Fixed one broken link in concepts/capacity-ops.md.
Jon: Heads up from SRE — avoid publishing p95 latency as a hard SLA. We can document SLO guidance but mark it non-contractual. I'll add exact phrasing.
Ash: Added two quick SDK snippets for PR. Python copy/paste friendly: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$RW_KEY")
res = client.dedicated.create(name="team-b-prod", region="us-east-1", instance_type="a100-80gb", autoscale={"min_instances":2, "max_instances":8, "cpu_target_pct":70})
print(res)
```
Nash: For JS: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.dedicated.create({ name: 'team-b', region: 'us-west-2', instance_type: 'a10g', autoscale: { min_instances: 1, max_instances: 4 } })
```
Priya: Nice. I'll add IAM/KMS callouts and a short note about required roles. Also adding a recommended defaults box: default cpu_target_pct=70, autoscale decision interval=30s.
Sam: Can we include a burst/canary example? Customers often ask for short spikes without overprovisioning.
Michelle: Yes — include a burst example under autoscale: `burst: { enabled: true, extra_instances: 2, cooldown_sec: 300 }` and a short explanation of cooldown behavior.
Nash: I pushed a small convert script for the migration guide (old keys min_nodes/max_nodes -> new min_instances/max_instances). Script snippet: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# convert_yaml.py - basic key rename for autoscale configs
import sys, yaml
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)
if 'autoscale' in data:
    a = data['autoscale']
    if 'min_nodes' in a:
        a['min_instances'] = a.pop('min_nodes')
    if 'max_nodes' in a:
        a['max_instances'] = a.pop('max_nodes')
with open('converted.yaml', 'w') as out:
    yaml.safe_dump(data, out)
```
Oliver: Tiny nit — mention that cpu_target_pct is applied per-instance and that recommended range is 50-80%. Otherwise users set weird values.
Priya: Good call. Also adding a recommended rollout checklist to guides/dedicated-migration.md: backup -> convert -> validate in staging -> 10% rollout -> monitor cost & latency.
Jon: I'll provide SRE-approved wording: "Dedicated SLA: 99.95% monthly control-plane availability. Latency figures are SLOs and depend on model, sequence length, and provisioned capacity; they are not contractual." Flagging legal review on SLA text.
Michelle: Perfect. Can someone sanity-check the isolation paragraph? We should contrast Dedicated vs Private Dedicated (control plane vs VPC, network isolation, KMS options).
Sam: I'll add short bullets: Dedicated = shared control plane, isolated GPUs, tenant data scoped and encrypted; Private Dedicated = customer VPC, control-plane proxy, optional on-prem, HSM/KMS integration.
Priya: Found another broken link in capacity-ops.md that pointed to /old/dedicated. Updated to /guides/dedicated-overview and added a redirect note.
Michelle: Please also add a one-line cross-link to Console per-route metrics in the TOC. I want merge-ready after legal ok on SLA and SRE ack. Timeline: aiming to ship docs update by EOD Friday.
Docs-bot: PR #492 status changed to "changes requested" — Michelle requested reviews from @Priya, @Jon, @Nash.
Priya: I'll push edits tonight and add the example timeline graph for burst/cooldown. Will ping when done.
Michelle: Thanks all. If anyone spots more bad links or needs to add screenshots, drop them here.
Jon: I can give SRE ack by Thursday PM. :+1:

Nash: Taking a pass on the CLI examples and adding a small note about API quotas and default rate limits.
Oliver: Approved small copy edits.
Michelle: Merging after legal and SRE OK. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
